text: Any man with a trailer needs a set of these. These are Rhino's brand new stake pocket ICMs. And once you've had a set of these, you'll never go back to this tangled mess. They come with two stake pockets, two pins, two retractable ratchet straps, as well as Rhino's lifetime warranty, and a camo bag to store them in. And what I love is that they're interchangeable with the truck bed ICMs too. This is a brand new release from Rhino and they don't have that many left in stock, but if you still see that link at the bottom, you can get some before they're all gone.
